steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Asteroids are rocky/metallic bodies, mostly found in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter | Key Fact: Comets are icy bodies that develop a coma and tail when they approach the Sun | Key Fact: A comet has a nucleus (solid core), coma (gas/dust cloud) and two tails: ion tail (pointing directly away from the Sun) and dust tail (curved) | Key Fact: Short-period comets originate from the Kuiper belt; long-period comets from the Oort cloud

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from asteroids, comets &amp; meteoroids, and one past-paper question.
